newsitem.title: CHINA: China's PICC Property insures BP JV for $172 mln.
newsitem.headline: China's PICC Property insures BP JV for $172 mln.

text.p: The People's Insurance Company of China Property has agreed to offer $172 million insurance cover for a joint venture involving British Petroleum Co PLC, official media said on Friday.

PICC Property, a unit of PICC Group, signed a contract with Yangtzejiang Acetyl Petrochemical Co Ltd, a joint venture between BP and the Sichuan Vinylon Factory, a subsidiary of Sinopec, the Financial News said.
PICC Property would provide all-risk insurance cover for installation engineering work at the project, it said. The contract was signed in the southwest city of Chongqing where the project is based.
Total investment in the joint venture company would reach $204 million, it said.
The project is expected to start production by end-1998, with capacity to produce 150,000 tonnes of acetic acid per year, it said.
